title: Animated signature
slide_intent: Connect a symbol to its name over time because viewers may recognize one before the other.
strategic_value: The Freddie-to-wordmark reveal can establish the relationship between Mailchimp’s character and name.
demonstration: The short yellow-backed loop starts with Freddie alone and reveals the bold lowercase wordmark beside it.
practical_value: Compare a staged logo reveal with a static lockup.
